scope: Encoded: the National-Civic Service Law s 36(a), (b) and s 37(f) as a bound, and the end of s 348(e)'s temporary text (forks C1 to C3); s 341 and the Order of 5759-1999 ss 1, 3, 4 (fork O1); the several-employers regulations 1 to 9 (forks N1, N2); Schedule K1 and s 369(a) (forks K1 to K3); s 2 and Schedule A (fork W1); ss 28, 28A, 28B, 32 (forks S1, S2); ss 336, 340, 340A, 343 with the temporary figures of Amendment 252; ss 344, 344A, 345, 345A, 345B, 346, 347 (forks D1, D2); ss 349, 350, 350A, 351 and Schedule K16 (forks L1, L2). Refused by name (needs a source): the Institute's charge on yeshiva students; the Minister's orders; the Civic Service Law after 2026-04-01. Not re-encoded: Schedule A1 Parts A, B, C, E (row IL-33), Part D (row IL-08). Out of scope: ss 29 to 31, 33 to 36, 352, s 369 beyond (a).

period_answered.text: s 340(d), (e), 340A from 1.1.2025 (earlier days refused by name); the Order from 1.1.1999 (earlier days refused by name), its amount since 2026 through row IL-04's s 334(a) (2027 on declined by IL-04's own messages); s 32(a) from 2018; s 350A from 1.1.2026 to 31.12.2035; the Civic Service Law up to the text of 2026-04-01 (later days declined where the answer turns on them)

expected_red.why: Added 2026-11-09. A finding about the REGULATION of 5757-1997, not about the Law or this encoding: reg 1 names column E of Schedule J and half the average wage for 'the full rate' (and reg 2 half the average wage), where the Law's s 342(e)(3) has named column D and 60% of the average wage since 1 January 2006 (Sefer HaChukim 2023 p. 809, s 66(3)(a); s 80(a) and (k)) and the reduced collection threshold since 1 January 2026 (Sefer HaChukim 3384 p. 396, s 19(4); s 21). The regulation was never conformed. The 4 failures are: the column (1), the threshold in reg 1 against the Law of 2006 to 2025 (2) and of 2026 (3), the threshold in reg 2 against the Law of 2026 (4); the 5 passing assertions show the regulation matched the Law and Schedule J as made in 1997. Reg 1 and reg 2 as made were read from the page image of Kovetz HaTakanot 5835 p. 864 (a scan hosted by olaw.org.il, a private archive of Reshumot issues), and the Law's text from the Knesset's PDFs of Sefer HaChukim 1607, 2023 and 3384, not only from the consolidations; the Kovetz HaTakanot indexes after 1999 were not checked. NOTES.md section 14. Gates nothing: this row takes the full rate and the threshold as inputs.
fid-il-34: C143-C147 divide by the printed total 14.60; the plain list form of s 28(a) divides by the sum of the cells (14.49); fork R1 gives the printed-total form. C269 is declined by fork C1.

corrections.summary: Correction, not a new version (no version bump; the lead commits). IL-05's fork F22 and this row's notes (NOTES.md section 3, S4, the fid-il-34 notes) recorded 'column E' in s 342(e)(3)-(4) and in reg 1 as two instruments with the same defect. The official s 342(e)(3)-(4) have said column D since 1 January 2006 (Sefer HaChukim 2023 p. 809, s 66(3)(a)); the column E of s 342(e)(3)-(4) is the deposited consolidation's error. The live defect is in the REGULATION: reg 1 still says column E and half the average wage. Changes: comments in nii-s342e-several-employers.l4 (no rule, no test and no count changed); a new expected-red module nii-il34-tests-expected-red.l4 (4 failed, 5 satisfied) wired into check.sh and expected_red; NOTES.md section 14 and corrected sentences in section 3; dated notes in DECIDED-ANSWERS.md and INDEPENDENT-FINDINGS.md (their original lines stand); tests-independent.l4 unchanged (it asserts no column letter).

ruling: Every fork (seventeen) is ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG): one named switch, default declined, the other readings kept by name and tested; the default declines only where the readings give different answers to the question asked.
